chains.valid_statement_or_chain: QSZK subset QIP(2) intersect coQIP(2) subset PSPACE.
chains.unsupported_endpoint_transfer: Neither PP nor PSharpP nor CH follows from an NC algorithm on exponential-size explicit matrices.

chains.valid_statement_or_chain: QSZK protocols admit quantum linear-space honest provers using single-exponential time in transcript qubits.
chains.unsupported_endpoint_transfer: Linear space for an interactive honest prover does not give a polynomial-time or finite-counting-level decider.
restrictions: runtime measured in qubits rather than dimension

chains.valid_statement_or_chain: Different oracles obstruct QSZK subset PP and PP subset QSZK through NISZK and UP intersect coUP respectively.
chains.unsupported_endpoint_transfer: No ordinary separation or ZFC independence; the QSZK-versus-PP oracle does not automatically separate QSZK from larger PSharpP or CH.

chains.valid_statement_or_chain: PostBQP equals PP.
chains.unsupported_endpoint_transfer: Discarding a possibly exponentially unlikely conditioning event does not yield BQP=PP or PP subset QSZK.

chains.valid_statement_or_chain: If PP subset BQP/qpoly then CH=QMA=YQP*.
chains.unsupported_endpoint_transfer: No unconditional comparison; the nonuniform quantum advice and the premise cannot be removed.

chains.valid_statement_or_chain: QCPH subset P^(PP^PP); QCPH=QPH implies QMA2 subset CH.
chains.unsupported_endpoint_transfer: No unconditional QMA2 subset CH; mixed second-level PSPACE containment is insufficient for a hierarchy collapse.

chains.valid_statement_or_chain: QMA2 subset pureQΣ2 subset mixedQΣ3 subset NEXP; pureQPH=QPH as unions.
chains.unsupported_endpoint_transfer: Union equality with a level increase does not imply pureQΣ2=mixedQΣ2 or identify QPH with QCPH.

chains.valid_statement_or_chain: PureSuperQMA subset PSPACE and PureSuperQMA subset QMA2.
chains.unsupported_endpoint_transfer: The upper bound of a subclass is not an upper bound of QMA2; polynomial constraint count is essential.

chains.valid_statement_or_chain: QMA2 with logarithmically many gates crossing proof registers is in PSPACE.
chains.unsupported_endpoint_transfer: General polynomial-size verification may have polynomially many such gates.

chains.valid_statement_or_chain: Ordinary QMA2 admits amplification with increased witness size; an earlier stronger conjectural implication was withdrawn.
chains.unsupported_endpoint_transfer: Modern amplification does not discharge the older witness-size-preserving Strong Amplification premise.

chains.valid_statement_or_chain: Theorem1 reaches QMA+(2,1−1/p,1/4+1/p)=NEXP; Corollary2 embeds other inverse-gap parameters into this regime.
chains.unsupported_endpoint_transfer: At s=1/4+1/p, both min(1,4s) and min(1,8s) are1; no ordinary QMA2=NEXP.

chains.valid_statement_or_chain: postQMA2 with perfect completeness and constant soundness captures NEXP.
chains.unsupported_endpoint_transfer: An exponentially rare postselection event and exponentially small source gap cannot be omitted.

chains.valid_statement_or_chain: QIP_unent[3]=NEXP; QMA2 embeds by ignoring an exchange.
chains.unsupported_endpoint_transfer: The reverse simulation would have to remove adaptive interaction.

chains.valid_statement_or_chain: MA subset StoqMA subset SBP intersect QMA; near-perfect-completeness StoqMA is in MA.
chains.unsupported_endpoint_transfer: Common QMA/PP bounds do not compare StoqMA with BQP; perfect completeness/general amplification is not automatic.

chains.valid_statement_or_chain: StoqMA(k)=StoqMA for polynomial k and inverse-polynomial gap; Theorem5.1 retains gap11Delta/32.
chains.unsupported_endpoint_transfer: Entrywise nonnegative acceptance matrices are essential; general QMA2 and QMA+ verifiers need not have them.

chains.valid_statement_or_chain: StoqMA_log=BPP; precise-gap stoquastic variants have PSPACE/NEXP characterizations.
chains.unsupported_endpoint_transfer: Neither logarithmic witness length nor exponentially small gaps describe ordinary StoqMA; the earlier EXP bound is superseded by the May collapse.

chains.valid_statement_or_chain: Stoquastic sparse energy is StoqMA-complete; its separable version becomes StoqMA-complete through the May collapse.
chains.unsupported_endpoint_transfer: Completeness is not a BQP algorithm and does not prove hardness of every restricted physical subfamily.

chains.valid_statement_or_chain: Lee-Yang/Heisenberg families including weighted bipartite Quantum Max-Cut have quantum energy algorithms.
chains.unsupported_endpoint_transfer: No reduction from arbitrary StoqMA instances to these specified families was established by the checked results.

chains.valid_statement_or_chain: VGP-promised energy is StoqMA-complete; recognizing VGP is PSPACE-complete in the stated general setting.
chains.unsupported_endpoint_transfer: A hard recognition problem does not make the promised energy task PSPACE-hard or BQP-hard.

chains.valid_statement_or_chain: Positive tensor contraction has a BPP additive-1-norm approximation and StoqMA-hard multiplicative approximation.
chains.unsupported_endpoint_transfer: A polynomial bound connecting the two errors is required; it is not supplied by positivity.

chains.valid_statement_or_chain: A quantum guided ground-state sampler beats classical query algorithms for the constructed oracle family.
chains.unsupported_endpoint_transfer: This is not ordinary decision hardness, BQP completeness of stoquastic energy, or a separation of the roster endpoints.

transfer_policy: A promise-class inclusion transfers to total-language restrictions only with the source promise respected on every reduced input.
A separating promise problem need not yield a total-language separation.
Oracle/query and sampling results are not ordinary decision-class results or ZFC independence.
Keep advice, postselection, all-witness soundness, gap, register length, and exact verifier restrictions.
Do not infer membership in a subclass from a common superclass or an upper bound on an embedded subclass.
Counting levels are fixed before taking their union; polynomial-time PP access is distinct from PP with a PP oracle.
Counterfactual point counts are raw closure consequences among current candidates, not official eligibility or awarded points.

search_and_read_method.scope_limit: Targeted primary theorem and proof-interface reading, not a systematic census of every 2025–2026 publication or a re-proof of all analytic lemmas.

risk_assessment.reason: Specific failed transfers are now better documented, but this bounded search does not calibrate a reduction of an event probability for any unseen theorem. Shared source chains and recent-paper searches overlap the original ledger.
new_evidence: Pure/mixed hierarchy equality increases levels and cannot invoke the mixed second-level PSPACE bound.
May2026 StoqMA(k) collapse strengthens an intermediate bound without changing a scored comparison.
August2026 amplification formal body has a narrower claim than its abstract; sign/phase loss blocks ordinary QMA2 transfer.
Guided stoquastic oracle sampling and restricted Hamiltonian algorithms do not compare general decision endpoints.

limitations: No proof of openness or literature completeness.
No independent validation of every new analytic proof; accepted-proof flaws remain outside the requested residual-error target.
Separate reviewers own QSZK and real-feasibility semantic bridges.
Current candidate status may later be replaced by a release-level historical-review decision; this report records the reviewed snapshot.
